name: configure_plugin
description: Update an installed plugin's configuration parameters -- use this to set/change the values a plugin's own custom-config form exposes (API keys, polling interval, device-specific settings, etc.), typically while developing/testing a plugin locally. Call list_installed_plugins first to get the real plugin_id. For a plugin generated with OAuth support, pass key='oauth' to update its real client_id/client_secret/scope after generation (the generated server_entry.json only ever contains placeholders there, never real secrets).

config.description: The configuration parameters to set, as a JSON object of key/value pairs.

key.description: Which custom record to write. Defaults to 'customparams' (ordinary developer-defined config values); use 'oauth' to set the real OAuth client_id/client_secret/scope/endpoints for a plugin generated with OAuth support.
